meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, Database on Indian Economy (via the Data Bank)
meta.revisionPolicy: Weekly reserves and daily rates are final on release. Investment flows, ECBs and LRS are revised in later Bulletins; external debt is provisional for a quarter, then partially revised.
meta.product: Daily forward premia, USD/INR, in paise (DBIE report 767)

meta.note: RBI DBIE report 767, paise per US dollar, trading days. Where it overlaps report 698's paise columns (from September 2003) the two agree exactly; this table starts three years earlier. Its reference-rate column is left out (the reference rate is in external-rupee-daily).
